##02 Why Markdown matters

A creative format, not a developer tool.

Markdown is plain text with just enough structure. It is how writers draft, how designers spec, how PMs plan, and how AI already answers you.

01

Opens anywhere

Any editor, any OS, no licence, no lock-in. The file is the document.

02

AI reads it natively

Headings, lists and tables hand a model the structure, and chat assistants reply in it by default.

03

Versioned like code

Diff it, review it, keep its history in Git, next to the product it describes.

04

Made for makers

Notes, briefs, PRDs, design specs and prompts, all in one portable format.

##04 How design teams use Markdown

Design systems are becoming Markdown files.

Google

DESIGN.md is now open source

The format behind Stitch, released under Apache 2.0 in April 2026. Design tokens in YAML, design rules in prose, and a CLI that validates, diffs and exports to Tailwind.

blog.google ↗
Ai2

One DESIGN.md per product

Ai2 publishes self-contained DESIGN.md files for its design systems, for coding agents and developer tools to read.

github.com/allenai/design ↗
Atlassian

Portable design context, tested

Atlassian shipped its own DESIGN.md and wrote up what it learned using it in practice.

atlassian.com ↗
Razorpay Field note

PRDs in GitHub, not Confluence

Product requirement docs shared as Markdown files and maintained in GitHub. Its public docs already live as Markdown too.

github.com/razorpay/markdown-docs ↗

##07 Docs conversion

Structured conversion, not a text dump.

Most converters copy the text across line by line and lose the hierarchy. I ♥ MD rebuilds the document: real headings, tables for tabular data, and lists that stay numbered.

Reference: craftmarkdown.com · best PDF to Markdown converters

ilovemd.xyz/text

##08 Checked, not just generated

Every file checked against CommonMark.

CommonMark is the standard specification for Markdown. Every document I ♥ MD produces is checked against it, and problems are fixed inside the tool.

!

Flagged on the line ⚠ 1 issue

Line 11 jumps from H2 to H4. The marker sits in the gutter, next to the problem.

▲▼

Jump like Find

Step through every issue in the document with the arrows.

✓

Fix it, in place

One click repairs the line: unclosed fences, skipped headings, broken table rows.

↔

Live preview, any screen

Edit, split or preview. On phones the assistant becomes a bottom sheet.
